title.raw: 卷42 志十七 灾异三

sentences.zh: 志十七

translations.literal: Treatise 17
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 17

sentences.zh: 洪範曰：「木曰曲直。

translations.literal: The Great Plan says: "Wood is called bending and straightening."
translations.idiomatic: The Great Plan states, "Wood is defined as bending and straightening."

sentences.zh: 」木不曲直，則為咎徵。

translations.literal: "When wood does not bend and straighten, it becomes a sign of blame."
translations.idiomatic: When wood fails in this office, the result is a sign of cosmic blame.

sentences.zh: 凡恒雨、狂人、服妖、雞禍、鼠妖、木冰、木怪、青眚、青祥，皆屬之於木。

translations.literal: All persistent rain, madmen, garment prodigies, chicken calamities, rat prodigies, tree ice, tree monsters, green calamities, and green omens are all classified under wood.
translations.idiomatic: Persistent unseasonable rain, derangement, strange dress, chicken plagues, rat prodigies, ice on trees, tree anomalies, and green portents of every kind all belong to the element of wood.

sentences.zh: 順治二年二月，河源霪雨。

translations.literal: In the second month of Shunzhi 2 (1645), Heyuan had incessant rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi 2 (1645), Heyuan was battered by unrelenting rain.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，當塗恒雨。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, Dangtu had persistent rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi 3 (1646), Dangtu saw rain that would not cease.

sentences.zh: 四月，南雄霪雨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Nanxiong had incessant rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Nanxiong was deluged by prolonged downpours.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，章丘霪雨四十餘日。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year, Zhangqiu had incessant rain for more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Shunzhi 4 (1647), Zhangqiu endured incessant rain for more than forty days.

sentences.zh: 六月，高郵大雨數晝夜；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Gaoyou had heavy rain for several days and nights;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Gaoyou was lashed by heavy rain for several days and nights;

sentences.zh: 丘縣霪雨，平地水深二尺；

translations.literal: Qiu County had incessant rain, and the level ground stood two feet deep in water;
translations.idiomatic: Qiu County was flooded by incessant rain until the flatlands stood two feet deep;

sentences.zh: 蕭縣暴雨三閱月；

translations.literal: Xiao County had violent rain for three months;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao County was struck by torrential rain for three full months;

sentences.zh: 永安州、安邑大雨。

translations.literal: Yong'an Prefecture and Anyi had heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: Yong'an Prefecture and Anyi were hit by heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 秋，壽元霪雨四十餘日，即墨暴雨連綿，水與城齊，民舍傾頹無算。

translations.literal: In autumn, Shouyuan had incessant rain for more than forty days; Jimo had continuous violent rain, the water level even with the city walls, and common dwellings collapsed beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Shouyuan saw more than forty days of unbroken rain; in Jimo the downpours went on and on until the water stood level with the walls, and countless homes were wrecked.

sentences.zh: 五年春，新城霪雨六十餘日，水沒城及半；

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, Xincheng had incessant rain for more than sixty days, and the water submerged half the city;
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Shunzhi 5 (1648), Xincheng was drowned by more than sixty days of rain until the floodwaters reached halfway up the walls;

sentences.zh: 莒州大雨兩月；

translations.literal: Juzhou had heavy rain for two months;
translations.idiomatic: Juzhou was soaked by heavy rain for two months;

sentences.zh: 武城霪雨一百日；

translations.literal: Wucheng had incessant rain for a hundred days;
translations.idiomatic: Wucheng endured a hundred days of unbroken rain;

sentences.zh: 東平大雨渰禾。

translations.literal: Dongping had heavy rain that drowned the grain.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains at Dongping drowned the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 五月，衡水霪雨數旬；

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Hengshui had incessant rain for several ten-day periods;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Hengshui was swamped by weeks of incessant rain;

sentences.zh: 咸陽大雨四十餘日。

translations.literal: Xianyang had heavy rain for more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: Xianyang was drenched by heavy rain for more than forty days.

sentences.zh: 八月，句容大雨，屋舍傾圮無算；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Jurong had heavy rain, and dwellings collapsed beyond counting;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, a downpour at Jurong brought down houses beyond number;

sentences.zh: 陵川霪雨害稼；

translations.literal: Lingchuan had incessant rain that harmed the crops;
translations.idiomatic: Lingchuan's unbroken rains ruined the harvest;

sentences.zh: 沁水霪雨兩月餘。

translations.literal: Qinshui had incessant rain for more than two months.
translations.idiomatic: Qinshui saw more than two months of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，鳳陽霪雨八晝夜；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Fengyang had incessant rain for eight days and nights;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shunzhi 6 (1649), Fengyang was flooded for eight days and nights straight;

sentences.zh: 阜陽、淮河霪雨晝夜不息。

translations.literal: Fuyang and the Huai River region had incessant rain day and night without cease.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuyang and along the Huai, the rain fell day and night without pause.

sentences.zh: 秋，沁水霪雨兩月餘，民舍傾倒。

translations.literal: In autumn, Qinshui had incessant rain for more than two months, and common dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, Qinshui endured more than two months of rain until homes were toppling everywhere.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，全椒大雨。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, Quanjiao had heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi 7 (1650), Quanjiao was hit by heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 四月，射洪大雨三晝夜，城內水深丈許，人畜淹沒殆盡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Shehong had heavy rain for three days and nights; within the city the water was about a zhang deep, and people and livestock were nearly all drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, three days and nights of rain at Shehong left the city streets a zhang deep in water and drowned nearly every person and animal within the walls.

sentences.zh: 五月，平陽霪雨四十餘日。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Pingyang had incessant rain for more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Pingyang was drowned by more than forty days of rain.

sentences.zh: 六月，桐鄉霪雨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Tongxiang had incessant rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Tongxiang was soaked by unbroken rain.

sentences.zh: 七月，解州、萊陽、萬泉霪雨；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Jiezhou, Laiyang, and Wanquan had incessant rain;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Jiezhou, Laiyang, and Wanquan were all deluged;

sentences.zh: 安邑大雨二十餘日，傾圮民舍。

translations.literal: Anyi had heavy rain for more than twenty days, and common dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Anyi was lashed by heavy rain for more than twenty days, and countless homes were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 八年春，嘉興、海鹽、桐鄉霪雨。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year, Jiaxing, Haiyan, and Tongxiang had incessant rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Shunzhi 8 (1651), Jiaxing, Haiyan, and Tongxiang all suffered prolonged downpours.

sentences.zh: 五月，潞安霪雨八十餘日，傷禾稼，房舍傾倒甚多。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Lu'an had incessant rain for more than eighty days, harming the grain crops, and many houses collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Lu'an was drowned by more than eighty days of rain that ruined the crops and brought down a great many buildings.

sentences.zh: 六月，江陰霪雨六晝夜，禾苗爛死；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Jiangyin had incessant rain for six days and nights, and the grain seedlings rotted and died;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, six days and nights of rain at Jiangyin left the seedlings rotting in the fields;

sentences.zh: 吳平大雨傾盆，一晝夜方息；

translations.literal: Wuping had downpour rain as from a tipped basin, which ceased only after one day and night;
translations.idiomatic: At Wuping the rain fell in torrents for a full day and night before it stopped;

sentences.zh: 當塗大雨。

translations.literal: Dangtu had heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: Dangtu was hit by heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 秋，沁水大雨，東阿霪雨，青浦大雨彌日。

translations.literal: In autumn, Qinshui had heavy rain; Dong'e had incessant rain; Qingpu had heavy rain for a whole day.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn brought heavy rains to Qinshui, unbroken downpours to Dong'e, and a full day of torrential rain at Qingpu.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，陽信、霑化霪雨四十餘日，平地水深二尺；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, Yangxin and Zhanhua had incessant rain for more than forty days, and the level ground stood two feet deep in water;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shunzhi 9 (1652), Yangxin and Zhanhua were flooded for more than forty days until the flatlands stood two feet deep;

sentences.zh: 合浦大雨，城淹四尺。

translations.literal: Hepu had heavy rain, and the city was flooded four feet deep.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain at Hepu left the city four feet under water.

sentences.zh: 六月，壽陽霪雨四十餘日；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Shouyang had incessant rain for more than forty days;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Shouyang endured more than forty days of unbroken rain;

sentences.zh: 襄陵霪雨兩匝月，民舍漂沒甚多；

translations.literal: Xiangling had incessant rain for two full months, and many common dwellings were swept away and submerged;
translations.idiomatic: Xiangling was inundated for two full months, and a great many homes were washed away;

sentences.zh: 稷山霪雨；

translations.literal: Jishan had incessant rain;
translations.idiomatic: Jishan was deluged;

sentences.zh: 博興大雨傾盆四十七晝夜。

translations.literal: Boxing had downpour rain as from a tipped basin for forty-seven days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: At Boxing the rain poured down in torrents for forty-seven days and nights straight.

sentences.zh: 七月，濟寧、東平霪雨害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Jining and Dongping had incessant rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, prolonged rains at Jining and Dongping ruined the harvest.

sentences.zh: 九月，遵化州霪雨彌月。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Zunhua Prefecture had incessant rain for a full month.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Zunhua Prefecture saw rain that lasted a full month without letup.

sentences.zh: 十年五月，文安、大城、保定大雨如注十晝夜，平地水深二丈。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the tenth year, Wen'an, Dacheng, and Baoding had rain pouring down in torrents for ten days and nights, and the level ground stood two zhang deep in water.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shunzhi 10 (1653), Wen'an, Dacheng, and Baoding were lashed by torrential rain for ten days and nights until the flatlands stood two zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 六月，文登大雨三日，昌平霪雨，蓬萊霪雨四十餘日。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Wendeng had heavy rain for three days; Changping had incessant rain; Penglai had incessant rain for more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Wendeng was soaked for three days, Changping saw unbroken rain, and Penglai endured more than forty days of downpours.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，蘭州大雨二十餘日。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year, Lanzhou had heavy rain for more than twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi 11 (1654), Lanzhou was drenched for more than twenty days.

sentences.zh: 六月，亳州霪雨，壞民廬舍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Bozhou had incessant rain that destroyed common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, incessant rain at Bozhou wrecked countless homes.

sentences.zh: 七月，澄邁大雨，三日方止。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Chengmai had heavy rain, which ceased only after three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, heavy rain at Chengmai fell for three days before it stopped.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月，鶴峰州霪雨不止，田中水深三四尺。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twelfth year, Hefeng Prefecture had incessant rain without cease, and the fields stood three or four feet deep in water.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Shunzhi 12 (1655), unbroken rain at Hefeng Prefecture left the fields three or four feet deep in water.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月，常山大雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirteenth year, Changshan had heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shunzhi 13 (1656), Changshan was hit by heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 十五年二月，濟寧州霪雨傷麥，萬泉霪雨傷麥。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifteenth year, Jining Prefecture had incessant rain that harmed the wheat; Wanquan had incessant rain that harmed the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi 15 (1658), prolonged rains at Jining Prefecture and Wanquan alike ruined the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 秋，垣曲霪雨，儋州霪雨七晝夜，田禾多沒，城垣傾圮，興安、白河、洵陽霪雨四十餘日；

translations.literal: In autumn, Yuanqu had incessant rain; Danzhou had incessant rain for seven days and nights, and much of the grain in the fields was submerged, and the city walls collapsed; Xing'an, Baihe, and Xunyang had incessant rain for more than forty days;
translations.idiomatic: That autumn brought floods to Yuanqu; Danzhou was drowned for seven days and nights until crops and walls alike gave way; and Xing'an, Baihe, and Xunyang saw more than forty days of rain;

sentences.zh: 平湖大雨數晝夜，平地水深二尺許。

translations.literal: Pinghu had heavy rain for several days and nights, and the level ground stood about two feet deep in water.
translations.idiomatic: Several days and nights of rain at Pinghu left the flatlands about two feet deep in water.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月，震澤、嘉定霪雨六十日方霽。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixteenth year, Zhenze and Jiading had incessant rain for sixty days before it cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Shunzhi 16 (1659), Zhenze and Jiading endured sixty days of rain before the skies finally cleared.

sentences.zh: 二月，儀徵大雨彌月，平地水深丈餘。

translations.literal: In the second month, Yizheng had heavy rain for a full month, and the level ground stood more than a zhang deep in water.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, a month of rain at Yizheng left the flatlands more than a zhang deep in floodwater.

sentences.zh: 三月，蕭縣霪雨二十餘晝夜。

translations.literal: In the third month, Xiao County had incessant rain for more than twenty days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Xiao County was soaked for more than twenty days and nights straight.

sentences.zh: 秋，銅山霪雨三月餘，禾盡爛死；

translations.literal: In autumn, Tongshan had incessant rain for more than three months, and the grain all rotted and died;
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, more than three months of rain at Tongshan left every stalk rotting in the fields;

sentences.zh: 宿州大雨二十餘日，田廬漂沒殆盡；

translations.literal: Suzhou had heavy rain for more than twenty days, and fields and dwellings were nearly all swept away and submerged;
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou was flooded for more than twenty days until fields and homes were nearly all washed away;

sentences.zh: 虹縣霪雨六十餘日，平地水深丈餘，淹沒田廬；

translations.literal: Hong County had incessant rain for more than sixty days, the level ground stood more than a zhang deep in water, and fields and dwellings were submerged;
translations.idiomatic: Hong County endured more than sixty days of rain until the flatlands stood over a zhang deep and farms and houses were under water;

sentences.zh: 梧州霪雨四十餘日；

translations.literal: Wuzhou had incessant rain for more than forty days;
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhou was deluged for more than forty days;

sentences.zh: 成都霪雨城圮。

translations.literal: Chengdu had incessant rain, and the city walls collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Prolonged rain at Chengdu brought down the city walls.

sentences.zh: 十七年五月，崇明大雨一晝夜；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventeenth year, Chongming had heavy rain for one day and night;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shunzhi 17 (1660), Chongming was lashed by rain for a full day and night;

sentences.zh: 和平大雨，平地水深丈餘，漂沒田廬無算。

translations.literal: Heping had heavy rain, the level ground stood more than a zhang deep in water, and fields and dwellings swept away and submerged were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain at Heping left the flatlands more than a zhang deep and washed away farms and homes beyond number.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月，貴陽大雨，武寧霪雨二月未止。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year, Guiyang had heavy rain; Wuning had incessant rain for two months without ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Shunzhi 18 (1661), Guiyang was drenched by heavy rain while Wuning saw two months of downpours that would not end.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，孝感霪雨三日，殺麥。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month, Xiaogan had incessant rain for three days, destroying the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, three days of rain at Xiaogan ruined the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年八月，朝城霪雨七晝夜；

translations.literal: In the eighth month of Kangxi 1 (1662), Chaocheng had incessant rain for seven days and nights;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Kangxi 1 (1662), Chaocheng was flooded for seven days and nights straight;

sentences.zh: 曲沃霪雨二十日，壞城垣廬舍無算；

translations.literal: Quwo had incessant rain for twenty days, and city walls and dwellings destroyed were beyond counting;
translations.idiomatic: Quwo endured twenty days of rain that wrecked walls and homes beyond number;

sentences.zh: 成安霪雨五晝夜；

translations.literal: Cheng'an had incessant rain for five days and nights;
translations.idiomatic: Cheng'an was soaked for five days and nights;

sentences.zh: 永年霪雨匝月；

translations.literal: Yongnian had incessant rain for a full month;
translations.idiomatic: Yongnian saw a full month of unbroken rain;

sentences.zh: 吉州大雨，壞城垣廬舍；

translations.literal: Jizhou had heavy rain that destroyed city walls and dwellings;
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain at Jizhou brought down walls and houses;

sentences.zh: 蕭州大雨彌月，城垣傾圮；

translations.literal: Xiaozhou had heavy rain for a full month, and the city walls collapsed;
translations.idiomatic: A month of rain at Xiaozhou collapsed the city walls;

sentences.zh: 解州大雨四十日；

translations.literal: Jiezhou had heavy rain for forty days;
translations.idiomatic: Jiezhou was drenched for forty days;

sentences.zh: 猗氏大雨二十餘日，民舍傾圮。

translations.literal: Yishi had heavy rain for more than twenty days, and common dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: More than twenty days of rain at Yishi left homes collapsing throughout the district.

sentences.zh: 四年春，蠡縣霪雨二十餘日。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, Li County had incessant rain for more than twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Kangxi 4 (1665), Li County endured more than twenty days of rain.

sentences.zh: 六月，府穀大雨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Fugu had heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Fugu was hit by heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 閏六月，延安霪雨彌月，壞廬舍。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, Yan'an had incessant rain for a full month, destroying dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, a month of rain at Yan'an wrecked countless homes.

sentences.zh: 七月初七日，大城霪雨五晝夜，城垣倒壞十之六七，民房坍塌不下數萬間；

translations.literal: On the seventh day of the seventh month, Dacheng had incessant rain for five days and nights; six or seven tenths of the city walls collapsed, and no fewer than tens of thousands of common dwellings fell in ruin;
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh day of the seventh month, five days and nights of rain at Dacheng brought down six or seven tenths of the walls and collapsed no fewer than tens of thousands of homes;

sentences.zh: 東陽大雨，壞民舍。

translations.literal: Dongyang had heavy rain that destroyed common dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain at Dongyang wrecked many homes.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，福山霪雨兩月，禾稼盡傷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, Fushan had incessant rain for two months, and the grain crops were all harmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Kangxi 5 (1666), two months of rain at Fushan ruined the entire harvest.

sentences.zh: 十一月，襄垣、武鄉大雨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Xiangyuan and Wuxiang had heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Xiangyuan and Wuxiang were drenched by heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，惠來大雨，平地水深三尺；

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year, Huilai had heavy rain, and the level ground stood three feet deep in water;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Kangxi 6 (1667), heavy rain at Huilai left the flatlands three feet deep;

sentences.zh: 房縣霪雨傷禾。

translations.literal: Fang County had incessant rain that harmed the grain.
translations.idiomatic: Unbroken rain at Fang County ruined the crops.

sentences.zh: 七月，溫州大風雨，壞城垣廬舍；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Wenzhou had great wind and rain that destroyed city walls and dwellings;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a violent storm at Wenzhou wrecked walls and homes;

sentences.zh: 瑞安大風雨，壞城垣廬舍。

translations.literal: Ruian had great wind and rain that destroyed city walls and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Ruian was battered by wind and rain that brought down walls and houses.

sentences.zh: 七年四月，太平大雨如注。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the seventh year, Taiping had rain pouring down in torrents.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Kangxi 7 (1668), torrential rain fell at Taiping.

sentences.zh: 五月，太平積雨旬餘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Taiping had accumulated rain for more than ten days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Taiping saw more than ten days of steady rain.

sentences.zh: 六月，龍門大雨七日；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Longmen had heavy rain for seven days;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Longmen was soaked for seven days;

sentences.zh: 武強霪雨；

translations.literal: Wuqiang had incessant rain;
translations.idiomatic: Wuqiang was deluged;

sentences.zh: 井陘大雨如注。

translations.literal: Jingxing had rain pouring down in torrents.
translations.idiomatic: Torrential rain poured down on Jingxing.

sentences.zh: 七月，靈壽霪雨兩晝夜不止；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Lingshou had incessant rain for two days and nights without cease;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Lingshou was flooded for two days and nights without pause;

translations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth day of the fifth month of Yongzheng 1 (1723), heavy rain at Xiangshan left the markets navigable by boat;

sentences.zh: 湖州恒雨，自秋及冬不絕。

translations.literal: Huzhou had persistent rain, from autumn through winter without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Persistent rain at Huzhou continued from autumn through winter without cease.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，麻城霪雨傷麥。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, Macheng had incessant rain that damaged the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yongzheng 2 (1724), incessant rain at Macheng ruined the wheat.

sentences.zh: 夏，獻縣大雨六十餘日。

translations.literal: In summer, Xian County had heavy rain for more than sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, Xian County endured more than sixty days of heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，上海霪雨害稼；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year, Shanghai had incessant rain that harmed the crops;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Yongzheng 3 (1725), incessant rain at Shanghai damaged the crops;

sentences.zh: 海豐大雨，至七月方止；

translations.literal: Haifeng had heavy rain, and only in the seventh month did it stop;
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain at Haifeng continued until the seventh month before it ceased;

sentences.zh: 東光大雨四十餘日。

translations.literal: Dongguang had heavy rain for more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: Dongguang saw more than forty days of heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 七月，青城霪雨兩月。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Qingcheng had incessant rain for two months.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Qingcheng endured two months of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 八月，平原霪雨凡百日。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Pingyuan had incessant rain altogether for a hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Pingyuan saw a hundred days of unceasing rain.

sentences.zh: 九月，順德大雨三月。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Shunde had heavy rain for three months.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Shunde endured three months of heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，震澤霪雨為災；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Zhenze had incessant rain that became a disaster;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Yongzheng 4 (1726), incessant rain at Zhenze brought disaster;

sentences.zh: 當塗、無為大雨彌月，田禾盡淹；

translations.literal: Dangtu and Wuwei had heavy rain for a full month, and the field grain was entirely flooded;
translations.idiomatic: A month of heavy rain at Dangtu and Wuwei wholly flooded the fields;

sentences.zh: 南陵霪雨，至秋不絕。

translations.literal: Nanling had incessant rain, continuing until autumn without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Incessant rain at Nanling continued unbroken until autumn.

sentences.zh: 六月，濰縣大風雨，壞民廬舍；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Weixian had a great wind and rain, destroying civilians' dwellings;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, a violent storm at Weixian destroyed many homes;

sentences.zh: 慶陽大雨，平地水深四五尺。

translations.literal: Qingyang had heavy rain, and on level ground the water stood four or five chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain at Qingyang left the flatlands four or five chi deep.

sentences.zh: 七月，陽信霪雨連旬。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Yangxin had incessant rain for more than ten days.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Yangxin saw more than ten days of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 八月，杭州、嘉興、湖州大雨；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou had heavy rain;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, heavy rain fell at Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou;

sentences.zh: 青浦、蘇州、昆山霪雨十餘日，害稼。

translations.literal: Qingpu, Suzhou, and Kunshan had incessant rain for more than ten days, harming the crops.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten days of incessant rain at Qingpu, Suzhou, and Kunshan damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，吳興霪雨，鍾祥雨至四月不絕。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, Wuxing had incessant rain, and at Zhongxiang rain continued until the fourth month without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yongzheng 5 (1727), Wuxing saw incessant rain; at Zhongxiang rain continued unbroken until the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 五月，鎮海霪雨彌月。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Zhenhai had incessant rain for a full month.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Zhenhai endured a full month of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 六月，揭陽、饒平霪雨一月。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Jieyang and Raoping had incessant rain for one month.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Jieyang and Raoping endured a month of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 七月，惠來大雨害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Huilai had heavy rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, heavy rain at Huilai damaged the crops.

translations.literal: Lu'an Prefecture and Huoshan had incessant rain for more than forty days and nights;
translations.idiomatic: Incessant rain at Lu'an Prefecture and Huoshan lasted more than forty days and nights;

sentences.zh: 陽信霪雨七晝夜，民舍傾圮甚多。

translations.literal: Yangxin had incessant rain for seven days and nights, and many civilian dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Seven days and nights of incessant rain at Yangxin collapsed a great many homes.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，平利大雨，衝塌城垣六十餘丈。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Pingli had heavy rain, and more than sixty zhang of city wall was washed away and collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Yongzheng 6 (1728), heavy rain at Pingli breached more than sixty zhang of the city wall.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，陽春大雨，壞民居。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year, Yangchun had heavy rain, destroying civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yongzheng 7 (1729), heavy rain at Yangchun destroyed many homes.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，日照霪雨四十餘日。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year, Rizhao had incessant rain for more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Yongzheng 8 (1730), Rizhao saw more than forty days of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 六月，東阿、泰安、肥城大雨七晝夜，壞民田廬殆盡；

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, seven days and nights of heavy rain at Dong'e, Tai'an, and Feicheng nearly destroyed all fields and homes;

sentences.zh: 昌樂、諸城、掖縣、膠州、濰縣、日照、萊州霪雨兩月，壞廬舍無算。

translations.literal: Chang'le, Zhucheng, Yixian, Jiaozhou, Weixian, Rizhao, and Laizhou had incessant rain for two months, and the dwellings destroyed were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Two months of incessant rain at Chang'le, Zhucheng, Yixian, Jiaozhou, Weixian, Rizhao, and Laizhou destroyed untold numbers of dwellings.

sentences.zh: 七月，丘縣大雨傷禾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Qiu County had heavy rain that damaged the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, heavy rain at Qiu County damaged the grain crops.

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Jiaxing had heavy rain, and water harmed the crops;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, heavy rain at Jiaxing flooded and damaged the crops;

sentences.zh: 鄒平、銅陵霪雨害稼。

translations.literal: Zouping and Tongling had incessant rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Incessant rain at Zouping and Tongling damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 冬，齊河大風雨，傷禾稼。

translations.literal: In winter, Qihe had a great wind and rain, damaging the grain crops.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, a violent storm at Qihe damaged the grain crops.

sentences.zh: 九年二月，連州大風雨，拔樹倒屋。

translations.literal: In the second month of the ninth year, Lianzhou had a great wind and rain, uprooting trees and toppling houses.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yongzheng 9 (1731), a violent storm at Lianzhou uprooted trees and toppled houses.

sentences.zh: 六月，蒲台霪雨害稼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Putai had incessant rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, incessant rain at Putai damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 秋，普安州霪雨，至次年春乃霽。

translations.literal: In autumn, Pu'an Prefecture had incessant rain, and only in the spring of the following year did it clear.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, incessant rain at Pu'an Prefecture continued until the following spring before clearing.

sentences.zh: 十年六月，寧津大雨，平地行舟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year, Ningjin had heavy rain, and on level ground one could travel by boat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Yongzheng 10 (1732), heavy rain at Ningjin left the flatlands navigable by boat.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月，沔陽霪雨。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eleventh year, Mianyang had incessant rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yongzheng 11 (1733), Mianyang saw incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 六月二十八日，景寧大雨。

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth day of the sixth month, Jingning had heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day of the sixth month, heavy rain fell at Jingning.

sentences.zh: 橋梁道路衝塌甚多。

translations.literal: Many bridges and roads were washed away and collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Many bridges and roads were washed out and collapsed.

sentences.zh: 十二年春，五河霪雨。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twelfth year, Wuhe had incessant rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Yongzheng 12 (1734), Wuhe endured incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月，廣陽霪雨四十餘日。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirteenth year, Guangyang had incessant rain for more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Yongzheng 13 (1735), Guangyang saw more than forty days of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年八月，平陽大風雨七晝夜，田禾盡沒；

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Qianlong, Pingyang had a great wind and rain for seven days and nights, and the field grain was entirely submerged;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Qianlong 2 (1737), a violent storm at Pingyang raged for seven days and nights and wholly submerged the crops;

sentences.zh: 祁州霪雨害稼；

translations.literal: Qizhou had incessant rain that harmed the crops;
translations.idiomatic: Incessant rain at Qizhou damaged the crops;

sentences.zh: 蔚州大雨三晝夜。

translations.literal: Weizhou had heavy rain for three days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhou saw three days and nights of heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 九月，長子大雨，禾盡沒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Changzi had heavy rain, and the grain was entirely submerged.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, heavy rain at Changzi wholly submerged the grain crops.

sentences.zh: 三年秋，祁州大雨。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the third year, Qizhou had heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Qianlong 3 (1738), Qizhou saw heavy rain.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，高要霪雨，壞民房。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, Gaoyao had incessant rain, destroying civilian houses.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Qianlong 4 (1739), incessant rain at Gaoyao destroyed many homes.

sentences.zh: 六月，瓊州霪雨閱月；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Qiongzhou had incessant rain for a full month;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Qiongzhou endured a full month of incessant rain;

sentences.zh: 東明大雨，平地水深三尺。

translations.literal: Dongming had heavy rain, and on level ground the water stood three chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain at Dongming left the flatlands three chi deep.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，絳縣大雨害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, Jiang County had heavy rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Qianlong 5 (1740), heavy rain at Jiang County damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，寧都霪雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year, Ningdu had incessant rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Qianlong 6 (1741), Ningdu saw incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 七年春，商南霪雨一百餘日。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year, Shangnan had incessant rain for more than a hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Qianlong 7 (1742), Shangnan endured more than a hundred days of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 五月，山陽大雨，鹽城霪雨害禾稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Shanyang had heavy rain, and Yancheng had incessant rain that harmed the grain crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, heavy rain at Shanyang and incessant rain at Yancheng damaged the grain crops.

sentences.zh: 秋，泰州霪雨，阜陽霪雨一百二十餘日。

translations.literal: In autumn, Taizhou had incessant rain, and Fuyang had incessant rain for more than a hundred and twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, Taizhou saw incessant rain; at Fuyang incessant rain lasted more than a hundred and twenty days.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，慶陽霪雨浹旬。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year, Qingyang had incessant rain for ten days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Qianlong 8 (1743), Qingyang endured ten days of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，資陽、仁壽、射洪暴雨如注，壞民房。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year, Ziyang, Renshou, and Shehong had torrential rain pouring down like a deluge, destroying civilian houses.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Qianlong 9 (1744), torrential rain like a poured-down deluge at Ziyang, Renshou, and Shehong destroyed many homes.

sentences.zh: 七月，遂安霪雨六晝夜。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Suian had incessant rain for six days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Suian saw six days and nights of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 十年四月十六日，安遠驟雨，平地水高一丈餘，衝倒民房七百餘間。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the fourth month of the tenth year, Anyuan had a sudden downpour, and on level ground the water stood more than one zhang high, washing down and toppling more than seven hundred civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day of the fourth month of Qianlong 10 (1745), a sudden deluge at Anyuan left the flatlands more than one zhang deep and toppled more than seven hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 十一年五月，平度大雨，漂沒田禾；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eleventh year, Pingdu had heavy rain, and the field grain was washed away and submerged;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Qianlong 11 (1746), heavy rain at Pingdu washed away and submerged the crops;

sentences.zh: 膠州霪雨害稼。

translations.literal: Jiaozhou had incessant rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Incessant rain at Jiaozhou damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 六月，文登大雨傷禾；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Wendeng had heavy rain that damaged the grain;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, heavy rain at Wendeng damaged the grain crops;

sentences.zh: 壽光、諸城霪雨閱月，田禾盡沒。

translations.literal: Shouguang and Zhucheng had incessant rain for a full month, and the field grain was entirely submerged.
translations.idiomatic: A full month of incessant rain at Shouguang and Zhucheng wholly submerged the crops.

sentences.zh: 十一月，高密霪雨兩月。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Gaomi had incessant rain for two months.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Gaomi endured two months of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月，福山、棲霞、文登霪雨匝月。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twelfth year, Fushan, Qixia, and Wendeng had incessant rain for a full month.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Qianlong 12 (1747), Fushan, Qixia, and Wendeng endured a full month of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 七月，海豐大風雨，壞城垣數十丈；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Haifeng had a great wind and rain, destroying several tens of zhang of city wall;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a violent storm at Haifeng breached several tens of zhang of the city wall;

sentences.zh: 平陰、榮成大風雨，晚禾盡沒。

translations.literal: Pingyin and Rongcheng had a great wind and rain, and the late-season grain was entirely submerged.
translations.idiomatic: Violent storms at Pingyin and Rongcheng wholly submerged the late-season crops.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月初五日，清河大風雨，民舍傾圮無數。

translations.literal: On the fifth day of the fourth month of the twelfth year, Qinghe had a great wind and rain, and countless civilian dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day of the fourth month of Qianlong 12 (1747), a violent storm at Qinghe collapsed untold numbers of homes.

sentences.zh: 五月，泰州、通州大風雨，拔木壞屋。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Taizhou and Tongzhou had a great wind and rain, uprooting trees and destroying houses.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, violent storms at Taizhou and Tongzhou uprooted trees and destroyed houses.

sentences.zh: 十四年秋，清河霪雨兩月。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourteenth year, Qinghe had incessant rain for two months.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Qianlong 14 (1749), Qinghe endured two months of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月，高密霪雨害稼。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifteenth year, Gaomi had incessant rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Qianlong 15 (1750), incessant rain at Gaomi damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 六月，麻城大雨連旬，衝塌民房。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Macheng had heavy rain for more than ten days in succession, washing away and collapsing civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, more than ten days of heavy rain at Macheng washed out and collapsed many homes.

sentences.zh: 十六年秋，平度州大雨兩月，福山、棲霞、榮成霪雨害稼。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the sixteenth year, Pingdu Prefecture had heavy rain for two months, and Fushan, Qixia, and Rongcheng had incessant rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Qianlong 16 (1751), two months of heavy rain at Pingdu Prefecture and incessant rain at Fushan, Qixia, and Rongcheng damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 十七年八月，海豐大雨，淹沒田禾。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year, Haifeng had heavy rain, submerging the field grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Qianlong 17 (1752), heavy rain at Haifeng submerged the crops.

sentences.zh: 十八年，高平自七月至十月霪雨；

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Gaoping had incessant rain from the seventh month through the tenth month;
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 18 (1753), Gaoping saw incessant rain from the seventh month through the tenth month;

sentences.zh: 諸城大風雨，損禾。

translations.literal: Zhucheng had a great wind and rain, damaging the grain.
translations.idiomatic: A violent storm at Zhucheng damaged the grain crops.

sentences.zh: 九月，解州陰雨連旬。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Jiezhou had overcast rain for more than ten days in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Jiezhou saw more than ten days of overcast rain.

sentences.zh: 十九年八月，石門大雨淹禾稼；

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the nineteenth year, Shimen had heavy rain that submerged the grain crops;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Qianlong 19 (1754), heavy rain at Shimen flooded the crops;

sentences.zh: 桐鄉大雨數晝夜，淹禾稼；

translations.literal: Tongxiang had heavy rain for several days and nights, submerging the grain crops;
translations.idiomatic: Several days and nights of heavy rain at Tongxiang flooded the crops;

sentences.zh: 嘉興大風雨一晝夜，傷稼；

translations.literal: Jiaxing had a great wind and rain for one day and night, damaging the crops;
translations.idiomatic: One day and night of violent storm at Jiaxing damaged the crops;

sentences.zh: 日照霪雨。

translations.literal: Rizhao had incessant rain.
translations.idiomatic: Rizhao saw incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月至四月，蘇州霪雨，麥苗腐。

translations.literal: From the second month through the fourth month of the twentieth year, Suzhou had incessant rain, and the wheat seedlings rotted.
translations.idiomatic: From the second month through the fourth month of Qianlong 20 (1755), incessant rain at Suzhou rotted the wheat seedlings.

sentences.zh: 三月，蘄州大風雨，壞民居三百餘家；

translations.literal: In the third month, Qizhou had a great wind and rain, destroying more than three hundred civilian households;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, a violent storm at Qizhou destroyed more than three hundred homes;

sentences.zh: 荊門州霪雨兩月不絕。

translations.literal: Jingmen Prefecture had incessant rain for two months without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Jingmen Prefecture endured two months of unceasing rain.

sentences.zh: 五月，澄海狂風驟雨，衝倒城垣五十七丈，民房三百餘間。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Chenghai had a raging wind and sudden rain, washing down and toppling fifty-seven zhang of city wall and more than three hundred civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, a furious gale and sudden deluge at Chenghai toppled fifty-seven zhang of city wall and more than three hundred homes.

sentences.zh: 六月，蘇州大雨傷稼，高郵霪雨四十餘日。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Suzhou had heavy rain that damaged the crops, and Gaoyou had incessant rain for more than forty days.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, heavy rain at Suzhou damaged the crops; Gaoyou saw more than forty days of incessant rain.

sentences.zh: 七月，贛榆大風雨害稼，石門、桐鄉霪雨害稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Ganyu had a great wind and rain that harmed the crops; Shimen and Tongxiang had incessant rain that harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a violent storm at Ganyu and incessant rain at Shimen and Tongxiang damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 八月，東明大風雨拔木，田禾盡淹；

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Dongming had a great wind and rain that uprooted trees, and the field grain was entirely flooded;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, a violent storm at Dongming uprooted trees and wholly flooded the fields;

sentences.zh: 沂州恒雨。

translations.literal: Yizhou had persistent rain.
translations.idiomatic: Persistent rain hung over Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 十月，潮州霪雨損麥。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Chaozhou had incessant rain that damaged the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, incessant rain at Chaozhou damaged the wheat crop.

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tongzhi 2 (1863), Huang County saw rain with tree ice.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，武昌雨木冰。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, Wuchang had rain with tree ice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tongzhi 4 (1865), Wuchang saw rain with tree ice.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年十二月，黃岡雨木冰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of Guangxu 7, Huanggang had rain with tree ice.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Guangxu 7 (1881), Huanggang saw rain with tree ice.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，南陵上北鄉郭氏墓域有黃檀一株，腹內突產修竹數竿，外並無竹，觀者詫為異。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 1, in the northern part of Nanling at the Guo family grave plot in Shangbei Township, there was one yellow sandalwood tree; within its trunk bamboo shoots suddenly sprouted, several stalks, while outside there was no bamboo at all; onlookers marveled at it as strange.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 (1644), at the Guo family grave in Shangbei Township, Nanling, a yellow sandalwood tree suddenly produced several stalks of fine bamboo from within its trunk though no bamboo grew nearby—a prodigy that astonished all who saw it.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，石門資福院僧鋸木，中有「太平」二字，墨痕宛然。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year, a monk at Zifu Temple in Shimen sawed wood, and within it were the two characters "Great Peace," the ink marks clear as if freshly written.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Shunzhi 2 (1645), a monk at Zifu Temple in Shimen sawed into a log and found the characters "Taiping" etched within, the ink marks still perfectly clear.

sentences.zh: 三年，錢塘李樹生桃實；

translations.literal: In the third year, Qiantang had a plum tree produce peach fruit;
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3 (1646), a plum tree at Qiantang bore peaches;

sentences.zh: 太蒼街銀杏樹孔中吐火，而木本無傷。

translations.literal: On Taicang Street a ginkgo tree spat fire from a hole, yet the tree itself was unharmed.
translations.idiomatic: On Taicang Street a ginkgo tree belched fire from a hole in its trunk, yet the wood itself was uninjured.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，昆山西門外民家李樹生黃瓜。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, outside the west gate of Kunshan at a civilian household a plum tree produced cucumbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shunzhi 4 (1647), a plum tree at a home outside Kunshan's west gate bore cucumbers.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，封川李樹生桃。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year, Fengchuan had a plum tree produce peaches.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Shunzhi 6 (1649), a plum tree at Fengchuan bore peaches.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月初二日，婺源西寧村有楓樹自仆，居民薪其枝殆盡，十九夜有聲，樹忽自起。

translations.literal: On the second day of the seventh month of the eleventh year, in Xining Village, Wuyuan, there was a maple tree that fell of itself; the residents used its branches for firewood until nearly all were gone; on the night of the nineteenth there was a sound, and the tree suddenly rose of itself.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the seventh month of Shunzhi 11 (1654), a maple tree in Xining Village, Wuyuan, toppled of its own accord; the villagers burned nearly all its branches for fuel—but on the night of the nineteenth it gave a sound and suddenly stood upright again.

sentences.zh: 十二年三月，盧龍城東南角樓壁中出火，焚樓柱。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twelfth year, fire issued from within the wall of the southeast corner tower of Lulong city and burned the tower pillars.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Shunzhi 12 (1655), fire burst from the wall of the southeast corner tower at Lulong and consumed the tower's pillars.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月，曲陽文廟東古楊樹一株忽自焚，火數十丈，竟日不絕。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the thirteenth year, one ancient poplar east of the Confucian Temple at Quyang suddenly burned of itself; the flames reached several tens of zhang and did not cease all day.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shunzhi 13 (1656), an ancient poplar east of the Confucian Temple at Quyang burst into flame of its own accord; the fire rose dozens of zhang and burned without ceasing all day.

sentences.zh: 十八年五月，石門李樹生黃瓜，長二寸，有子。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighteenth year, at Shimen a plum tree produced cucumbers two cun long, with seeds.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shunzhi 18 (1661), a plum tree at Shimen bore cucumbers two cun long, complete with seeds.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年六月，盧龍灤河溢，湧出材木無算，時修清節祠，適所用，有如夙構，人鹹驚異。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Kangxi 3, the Luan River at Lulong overflowed and surged forth timber beyond counting; at the time the Qingjie Shrine was under repair, and the timber was exactly what was needed, as though prepared in advance; people all marveled at it as strange.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Kangxi 3 (1664), the Luan River at Lulong overflowed and cast up untold amounts of timber—just as the Qingjie Shrine was being repaired and lumber was needed, as if arranged beforehand; all who saw it were astonished.

sentences.zh: 十三年春，含山、嘉定李樹生黃瓜。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirteenth year, Hanshan and Jiading had plum trees produce cucumbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Kangxi 13 (1674), plum trees at Hanshan and Jiading bore cucumbers.

sentences.zh: 十六年，桐鄉李樹生黃瓜。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Tongxiang had a plum tree produce cucumbers.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 16 (1677), a plum tree at Tongxiang bore cucumbers.

sentences.zh: 十九年，封川李樹結桃實。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Fengchuan had a plum tree bear peach fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 19 (1680), a plum tree at Fengchuan bore peaches.

sentences.zh: 二十二年四月，東陽、義烏李樹生桃，櫨木開梨花。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-second year, Dongyang and Yiwu had plum trees produce peaches, and smoke trees bloomed pear blossoms.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Kangxi 22 (1683), plum trees at Dongyang and Yiwu bore peaches, and smoke trees put forth pear blossoms.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，海鹽鄉民鋸樹，中有「王大宜」三字，清晰如寫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, a villager at Haiyan sawed a tree, and within it were the three characters "Wang Dayi," as clear as if written.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 23 (1684), a villager at Haiyan sawed into a tree and found the name "Wang Dayi" inscribed within, as clear as if freshly written.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，黃岡李樹生黃瓜。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Huanggang had a plum tree produce cucumbers.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 28 (1689), a plum tree at Huanggang bore cucumbers.

sentences.zh: 四十五年四月，寧州通邊鎮白楊開花，狀如紅蓮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the forty-fifth year, at Tongbian Town, Ningzhou, white poplars bloomed, their form like red lotus flowers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Kangxi 45 (1706), white poplars at Tongbian Town, Ningzhou, bloomed in shapes like red lotus blossoms.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，秦州槐樹生蓮花。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year, Qinzhou had a locust tree produce lotus flowers.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 48 (1709), a locust tree at Qinzhou bore lotus flowers.

sentences.zh: 五十一年十一月，宿州樹頭生火。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifty-first year, Xiuzhou had fire appear atop a tree.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Kangxi 51 (1712), fire appeared at the top of a tree at Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，津縣西鎮門內有唐開元所植荔支，是歲忽枯，至九年復活，枝葉茂盛，不遜於前。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 5, inside the West Town Gate of Jin County there was a lychee tree planted in the Tang Kaiyuan reign; that year it suddenly withered; by the ninth year it revived, its branches and leaves flourishing, not inferior to before.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), a lychee tree inside Jin County's West Town Gate—planted in the Tang dynasty's Kaiyuan era—suddenly withered that year; by Yongzheng 9 (1731) it revived, its foliage as lush as ever.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，高淳李樹生黃瓜。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 1, Gaochun had a plum tree produce cucumbers.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 (1736), a plum tree at Gaochun bore cucumbers.

sentences.zh: 五年，掖縣縣署古桐自焚。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the ancient paulownia at the Ye County yamen burned of itself.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 5 (1740), the ancient paulownia at the Ye County yamen burst into flame of its own accord.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月，應城水陸寺楓樹夜放光，伐之乃滅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifteenth year, at the Shuilu Temple in Yingcheng a maple tree emitted light at night; only when it was cut down did the light cease.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Qianlong 15 (1750), a maple tree at Shuilu Temple in Yingcheng glowed at night; the light vanished only when the tree was felled.

sentences.zh: 四十八年六月，桐鄉李樹生黃瓜。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the forty-eighth year, Tongxiang had a plum tree produce cucumbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Qianlong 48 (1783), a plum tree at Tongxiang bore cucumbers.

sentences.zh: 六十年夏，竹城大雨溪漲，有巨木數百，順流而下，時修學宮無材，適符其數；

translations.literal: In the summer of the sixtieth year, Zhucheng had heavy rain and the streams rose; there were several hundred giant logs drifting downstream; at the time the school temple was under repair and lacked timber, and the number was exactly right;
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Qianlong 60 (1795), heavy rain at Zhucheng swelled the streams and hundreds of giant logs drifted downstream—just as the local school temple was being repaired and timber was needed, the supply arriving as if by design;

sentences.zh: 永嘉七聖廟大樟樹自焚，中藏竹箸無數。

translations.literal: At the Qisheng Temple in Yongjia a great camphor tree burned of itself; within it were stored countless bamboo chopsticks.
translations.idiomatic: A great camphor tree at Qisheng Temple in Yongjia burned of its own accord, revealing countless bamboo chopsticks stored within.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年秋，鄖陽漢川水中湧出巨木無算。

translations.literal: In the autumn of Jiaqing 1, at Hanchuan, Yunyang, countless giant logs surged up from the water.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Jiaqing 1 (1796), untold giant logs surged up from the waters at Hanchuan, Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 二年，枝江城東古樹作息哮聲。

translations.literal: In the second year, east of Zhijiang city an ancient tree made roaring sounds in its rising and resting.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 (1797), an ancient tree east of Zhijiang city made roaring sounds.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，曹縣李樹生瓜。

translations.literal: In Daoguang 2, Caoxian had a plum tree produce melons.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 2 (1822), a plum tree at Caoxian bore melons.

sentences.zh: 三年，隨州李樹生瓜。

translations.literal: In the third year, Suizhou had a plum tree produce melons.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 3 (1823), a plum tree at Suizhou bore melons.

sentences.zh: 咸豐六年六月，麗水大樹無故自倒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Xianfeng 6, Lishui had a great tree topple without cause of itself.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Xianfeng 6 (1856), a great tree at Lishui toppled without apparent cause.

sentences.zh: 八年，黃安有大椿樹，每至午，樹中有笑聲。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Huang'an had a great toona tree; each time noon arrived, there was laughter within the tree.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 8 (1858), at Huang'an a great toona tree emitted laughter from within at noon each day.

sentences.zh: 九年，武進李樹生瓜。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Wujin had a plum tree produce melons.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 9 (1859), a plum tree at Wujin bore melons.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，京山李樹結桃實。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi 3, Jingshan had a plum tree bear peach fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3 (1864), a plum tree at Jingshan bore peaches.

sentences.zh: 五年，分宜玉虛觀古梓杪產素心蘭。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, at the Yuxu Abbey in Fenyi, an ancient catalpa tree's crown produced plain-heart orchids.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5 (1866), the crown of an ancient catalpa at Yuxu Abbey in Fenyi produced plain-heart orchids.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，黃岡楓生梨實。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 3, Huanggang had a maple produce pear fruit.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 3 (1877), a maple at Huanggang bore pears.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，皋蘭民家杏樹開牡丹二朵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, at a civilian household in Gaolan an apricot tree opened two peony blossoms.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 22 (1896), an apricot tree at a home in Gaolan put forth two peony blossoms.

sentences.zh: 順治七年正月二十七日夜，望江西方有青氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the night of the twenty-seventh day of the first month of Shunzhi 7, at Wangjiang to the west there was green qi spanning the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-seventh day of the first month of Shunzhi 7 (1650), green qi arched across the sky west of Wangjiang.

sentences.zh: 康熙十七年六月十二日，平湖青眚見。

translations.literal: On the twelfth day of the sixth month of Kangxi 17, Pinghu saw green calamity appear.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth day of the sixth month of Kangxi 17 (1678), a green calamity appeared at Pinghu.
